business_summary: Parsons Corporation provides design, engineering and technical services, and smart and agile software for the United States federal government and critical infrastructure customers worldwide. It operates through Federal Solutions and Critical Infrastructure segments. The Federal Solutions segment offers critical technologies, such as cyber; air and missile defense; intelligence; aviation modernization; electronic warfare; space ground systems, cislunar, A-PNT, and classified sensors; geospatial and signals intelligence; environmental remediation; border security and counter-drug, critical infrastructure protection; counter unmanned air systems; biometrics; and bio surveillance solutions. This segment also provides software and hardware, and technical expertise; satellite ground systems support and operations, flight dynamics, data fusion and analytics, platform system integration, directed energy, joint all-domain operations, and command and control systems; digital landscape, including full-spectrum cyber, defensive cyber operations, information operations, and analytics; and electronic warfare, multi-domain operations, mission support and national to tactical operations, as well as cyber solutions and products. The Critical Infrastructure segment develops digital solutions for aviation, rail and transit, bridges, roads, highways, and urban destinations. This segment also provides planning, engineering, and management services for complex infrastructure comprising bridges, tunnels, roads and highways, and water and wastewater systems; intelligent transportation systems, utilities, environmental remediation, emerging contaminants, aviation, and rail and transit, as well as ParsonsX, a digital transformation organization; and multi-disciplinary design, technical, and management solutions. Parsons Corporation was founded in 1944 and is headquartered in Chantilly, Virginia.
business_summary_ko: Parsons Corporation은 미국 연방 정부와 전 세계 주요 인프라 고객을 위해 설계, 엔지니어링 및 기술 서비스와 스마트하고 민첩한 소프트웨어를 제공합니다. 연방 솔루션 및 중요 인프라 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. Federal Solutions 부문은 사이버와 같은 중요한 기술을 제공합니다. 공중 및 미사일 방어; 지능; 항공 현대화; 전자전; 우주 지상 시스템, cislunar, A-PNT 및 기밀 센서; 지리공간 및 신호 정보; 환경 개선; 국경 보안 및 마약 방지, 중요 인프라 보호; 카운터 무인 항공 시스템; 생체인식; 및 생물학적 감시 솔루션. 이 부문은 또한 소프트웨어, 하드웨어, 기술 전문 지식을 제공합니다. 위성 지상 시스템 지원 및 운영, 비행 역학, 데이터 융합 및 분석, 플랫폼 시스템 통합, 지향성 에너지, 공동 전체 도메인 운영, 명령 및 제어 시스템; 전체 스펙트럼 사이버, 방어적인 사이버 작전, 정보 운영 및 분석을 포함한 디지털 환경; 전자전, 다중 영역 작전, 임무 지원 및 국가에서 전술 작전까지
